subject: 14-week go-to-stability plan & kickoff timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@tidehaven.com>, Leah Brooks <leah@tidehaven.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: 14-week go-to-stability plan & kickoff timeline

Samir / Leah —

Great to meet virtually yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass 14-week plan that breaks the implementation into four phases: Intake & Prep (weeks 1–2), Integration & Validation (weeks 3–7), Tuning & Acceptance (weeks 8–11), and Go-live & Stabilization (weeks 12–14). Key highlights in this draft: 

- Clear milestone dates for infra readiness, data onboarding, and QA acceptance windows.
- Owner assignments by task (Redwood: infra, integration engineer; Tidehaven: API access, test data).
- Escalation path and a single point of contact for each phase.
- Minimal network & security prerequisites listed in the Network Requirements attachment.

Ask: please review the attached "Tidehaven_MAP_draft.xlsx" and confirm any internal constraints (procurement windows, blackout dates, or API freeze periods) by EOD Thursday so we can lock the kickoff date.

Proposed kickoff: Wednesday, Nov 18, 2026 — 60 minute technical + success alignment. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and pre-kickoff checklist.

Attachments: Tidehaven_MAP_draft.xlsx (proposed milestones & owners), network_requirements.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference runtime.

From: Samir Patel <samir@tidehaven.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Brooks <leah@tidehaven.com>, procurement@tidehaven.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 14-week go-to-stability plan & kickoff timeline

Aditya —

Appreciate the draft. Overall this looks reasonable and the four-phase split aligns to our expectations. A few notes from our end: 

- Procurement: purchase order will be issued by Nov 20; billing contact is procurement@tidehaven.com.
- API access: security team requires a temporary staging token policy and an IP allowlist — I attached no files yet but will share the contact details.
- Blackout: we have a business reporting window 11/22–11/26 where deep integration work should be minimized.

Kickoff: the proposed Nov 18 slot works for the core team. Please include a short pre-kick (30m) with our security contact if possible — CA timezone mornings are best.

I’ll confirm the procurement timeline formally by EOD 11/12.

Thanks — looking forward to starting.

Samir
VP Product | Tidehaven Logistics
samir@tidehaven.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@tidehaven.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Tidehaven kickoff prep & role split (Nov 18)

Team —

Samir confirmed Nov 18 for the customer kickoff; procurement will issue a PO ~Nov 20 and they flagged a reporting blackout 11/22–11/26. Key asks ahead of the kickoff: 

1) Pre-kick 30m with Tidehaven security (Monica) — schedule Tue 11/17 09:00 PT if available. Monica, can you lead the security pre-kick and review the staging token policy and IP allowlist?

2) Integration owner (Marissa) — please prepare a short runbook (10 slides) covering the integration flow we expect (auth, ingestion, testing harness) and a minimal validation checklist for weeks 3–7. Marissa, target to share slides by end of day 11/16.

3) Runtime/ops (Karthik) — prepare a capacity guideline and suggested instance/quantization profile for their initial workload (expected 2M tokens/day). Can you include a fallback plan for burst handling?

4) Success metrics (Neha) — define two success criteria for pilot acceptance (latency P95 < 300ms; accuracy baseline measured on sample set); draft these into the MAP sheet and highlight acceptance window.

I attached the draft MAP and network requirements that went to the customer. We’ll finalize owners and milestones during kickoff and produce a locked plan by Nov 20 to coincide with their PO timeline.

Thanks — short, sharp prep will save cycles in execution.

Aditya

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@tidehaven.com>, Leah Brooks <leah@tidehaven.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 14-week go-to-stability plan & kickoff timeline

All —

Thanks for the heads up. I met with Tidehaven's security lead (call notes below) and confirmed the following minimal checklist to unblock the staging integration: 

- Staging token policy: short-lived tokens (24h) scoped to the ingestion endpoint; we will provide an RBAC template.
- IP allowlist: Tidehaven will provide their staging IP range by 11/16; Redwood will confirm ingress rules and any VPN requirement by 11/17.
- Data retention: they require 30-day KV cache retention for debugging; flagged as "customer preference" (not required for compliance).

Action items I own before kickoff:
- Share RBAC/token template with Tidehaven by 11/16 (Monica)
- Confirm ingress rules with infra and send requirements to Tidehaven by 11/17 (Monica + Karthik)

Marissa — thanks for offering the integration runbook. If you can include a short troubleshooting play (3 common failure modes), that will reduce the initial war room load.

Neha — your acceptance criteria look good on the MAP sheet. Please add a small user-acceptance checklist (5 items) so Tidehaven knows the QA gating.

I’ll be on the kickoff on Nov 18 and will lead the security segment.

Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0145

Attachments referenced: Tidehaven_MAP_draft.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf
